title: Alternative Spyglass Crafting
description: Datapack / Mod that adds a different and more intuitive crafting recipe to the spyglass item.
body:
This datapack includes an alternative recipe for the spyglass. The recipe is made of 2 gold nuggets, 1 gold ingot, a block of glass and a copper ingot.

This is strictly needed to be crafted in a Crafting Table as usual.
